title: Operations New Enrichment Entry Permission Consistency

items.action: open and select generic operation creation entries
authorize the Enrichment operation start action
read the mandatory Enrichment manifest and output-field capabilities shown by the wizard

backend.reason: Enrichment immediate create/start authorization already uses fair_crm.scraper.execute.

api.reason: No API contract changes; the existing enrichment manifest endpoint remains governed by fair_crm.scraper.read.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

forms.reason: No business form behavior changes; the existing type-picker permission filter is reused.

notes: The Enrichment new-operation entry and deep link require fair_crm.scraper.execute plus fair_crm.scraper.read because the wizard cannot render its user-visible output-field configuration without the mandatory enrichment manifest. The final Enrichment Start action itself remains scraper.execute-only. fair_crm.fairs.read remains optional and controls only the org-wide fair filter. Generic operation entries continue to require fair_crm.operations.create, Bulk Email remains on fair_crm.fair_emails.execute, and Scraper keeps its separate execute + fairs.read + scraper.read entry prerequisites. The type picker and onContinue use the same fail-closed predicate.
